notes.title: Demo for Magnet Jack
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22979981/326cf888ddc3728e392d5ec36bc0ac64882fb06b.png[/img][h3]New project Magnet Jack is live with a DEMO![/h3]

[b]It's an action-oriented puzzle platformer (think Mario/Wario/Meatboy)

Play through the first world and a collection of demo stages gathered on DEMO ISLAND.

Magnet Jack has a fast-changing variety of wacky mechanics that'll make you think and challenge your reflexes. A Mario 3 style overworld with off-the-wall themes, ridiculous characters, and secrets to discover.[/b]

notes.title: Smoothness Update
notes.content:
I've rebuilt the game with an updated version of the engine used to make it. Confusing? Doesn't matter. Lil' Walker now walks as smooth as butter and that's all you need to know.

Thanks guys, toodles~

notes.title: Leaderboard Update
notes.content:
Remember when I said the last update would be the last update? JK, Now there's a global leaderboard for fastest time from the start of the game to the end.

If you use level select to start at waffle valley you don't need to start a new game to activate a valid run. Level warps and skips are valid, and that's pretty much all there is to it! 

I also added a button on the slide down menu for toggling the dropshadow shader, hopefully improved controller recognition, improved UI look, and fixed more sneaky bugs while I was at it.

Happy holidays everybody!

notes.title: Surprise, rando update
notes.content:
The game now recognizes if a controller is plugged in and automagically switches to controller mode. Something I should have done from the start, ha, oopsie daisy.

I also made some superficial changes to the title screen and implemented two lines of code that handle hitting your noggin' against the ceiling if it's a slope to make movement more smooth. wow.

And welp, that's all folks. This is probably the final update. I only did it because I was working on Homegrove and the code I came up with seemed like a good fit for Little Walker as well. Sayonara, have a good one, I'll miss you! Come visit anytime! 

[url=http://twitch.tv/flipswitchx] Me Dev Stream 	[/url]

notes.content:

~ HomeGrove ~

Discover
a charming yet dangerous world of friendly folk and menacing monsters. 

Acquire
new items and abilities, then use them as tools to solve problems, overcome obstacles, and interact with the landscape. 

Outsmart
Each new enemy poses a unique challenge with distinct strategies. Enemies won't be defeated with a simple jump or oversized swipe.

Explore
far from the titular home grove, and perhaps, if you want, uncover that there is more to this seemingly happy-go-lucky world than you had originally thought.

A blend of classic mechanics, some rarely seen in a side-scroller; meant to pay homage to greats of the past while accomplishing something they never did.

Other stuff to wet your whistle:
• Customizable controls
• Day/Night cycle
• Waiting for things to grow
• Hu-manz?
• A Flute

notes.title: My bad - How to restore your save!
notes.content:
Hi again! 

 I realized that while working on the cloudsave feature, I changed where the save files normally go. So you may start the game and be horrified to see your data missing, but it should still exist on your hard drive!

Here's what to do:

- Open steam
- Go to Library
- Right click Little Walker and go to Properties at the bottom.
- Click the Local Files tab, then click "Browse Local Files..."
- Cut or Copy the files that say "save" and "A", and simply paste them into the folder titled "saves"

That should do it! Sorry for the inconvenience. ^_^;
